How to chase late payments politely: a 3-step reminder email system

Chasing an invoice takes a few minutes. Rewriting the same awkward email every time is what eats the afternoon.

Copy this once:

"Write 3 payment reminder emails for [BUSINESS]. Email 1 (1 day late): friendly, assume it slipped. Email 2 (7 days): clear, restate the amount and how to pay. Email 3 (14 days): firm but polite, give a new date and the next step: [NEXT STEP]. Under 80 words each. Use placeholders for client, invoice, amount and dates."

Then:
1) Save the 3 drafts as templates.
2) Add calendar reminders for day 1, 7 and 14.
3) Fill in client details in your email app, not in the chat.

Only charge late fees your contract allows.
